title: Initial-object criterion for a map between left fibrations
statement: Use quasicategories, simplicial functors, coherent natural equivalences, initial objects and internal functor simplicial sets from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and left fibrations from [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $p:E\to B$ and $q:F\to B$ be left fibrations of quasicategories in one sufficiently large fixed universe. Let $u:E\to F$ be a simplicial map with $qu=p$, and let $e\in E$ be initial. If $u(e)$ is initial in $F$, then $u$ is an equivalence of quasicategories over $B$: there is a simplicial map $v:F\to E$ with $pv=q$ and coherent natural equivalences $vu\simeq\operatorname{id}_E$ and $uv\simeq\operatorname{id}_F$ over $B$. Here a coherent natural equivalence over $B$ is an equivalence in the simplicial set of functors over $B$: in degree $n$ its maps $E\times\Delta^n\to E$ or $F\times\Delta^n\to F$ compose to $p\operatorname{pr}_E$ or $q\operatorname{pr}_F$, respectively, including the inverse-equivalence witnesses.
